name: Sophie Wilmès - Proposition de la Commission au Conseil
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation establishing the Instrument for Nuclear Safety Cooperation and Decommissioning for the period 2028-2034 and repealing Regulations (Euratom) 2021/100 and (Euratom) 2021/948
part_text:
The European Parliament wants one shared fund for nuclear safety work outside the EU and for cleaning up the EU's own old research reactors, running from 2028 to 2034 with about 966 million euro. It asks for more transparency, regular information to Parliament, a clear strategy for choosing which countries and projects to support, and safeguards so EU money does not help rival non-European nuclear technology. Parliament's role here is only to give an opinion; the Council decides.

- What changes: two existing nuclear programmes merge into one fund of about 966 million euro for 2028–2034.
- Who it affects: countries receiving EU nuclear safety help, especially Ukraine, and four EU research sites being decommissioned.
- What happens next: the Council decides and must tell Parliament if it departs from this text.
